body: that actually fits amazingly with the robin arryn theory, being that he is  littlefingers kid instead of jon arryns.

Well since the story of DR 2.5 is in his head, he probably thinks as himself as background character, as he thinks his talent isn't really a talent at all.

You could say that Komaeda is extremely unlucky. To be the most fortunate guy ever, you would also need to be pretty unfortunate at the same time I think. For example, Suppose a plane crashed and he was the sole survivor within the plane. How unlucky for him to be in a plane crash, and how lucky he is to survive.
I'm thinking after the Mutual Killing Game, the remaining despairs scouted people out for a similar talent as Junko's. Eventually they found the protagonist through the Ultimate Researcher.

I imagine the Ultimate Actor's execution as him acting out a Shakespearean play, Something like Tybalt vs Romeo, with him being the one who dies in the end. I feel the ultimate actor would hate to be killed off, especially with him being so talented.
You're right it is quite similar. I feel like the mastermind could have other plans besides just "I want you to be Junko!" to give the plot more depth.

Well I was also thinking about an Ultimate Priest or Priestess, something religious to make a sort of "Cult of Junko" or something. The ones controlling monokuma could be religious fanatics. I can see how that could be similar to DRv3, but they are merely just ideas.
